metadata.title: Become a Workout Partner
metadata.description: Become a PacerGo workout partner and help people follow their training direction with human support.

hero.sub: PacerGo workout partners help users stay accountable, follow their training direction, and complete workouts with real human support.

role.intro: AI planning, workout partner support, professional coaching, and medical care are separate roles. A general workout partner helps with follow-through.

items.name: Train alongside users
items.body: Show up for the workout, help the session feel less isolated, and keep the effort moving.

items.name: Provide accountability
items.body: Be a reliable person who helps users follow the training direction they already have.

items.name: Support execution
items.body: Offer practical workout support while staying within your actual experience and qualifications.

who.title_1: You do not have to be a
who.intro: The current partner model supports different levels. Certification is not mandatory for every level, but any credential claim must be accurate.

items.title: Reliable people
items.body: Applicants should be able to communicate clearly, show up responsibly, and respect platform rules.

items.title: Experienced supporters
items.body: Relevant training experience can help users feel supported during workouts.

items.title: Qualified specialists
items.body: Some activities or levels require submitted proof before they can be listed.

items.title: Respectful partners
items.body: Partners should support users without making medical, rehabilitation, or unsupported professional claims.

levels.intro: PacerGo uses A, B, and C levels. A level badge is not automatically a professional certification.

items.name: C · Buddy
items.body: Open partner support for showing up, training alongside users, and helping with accountability.

items.name: B · Senior Pro
items.body: Requires approved proof for the selected activity before listing at this level.

items.name: A · Top Tier
items.body: Requires approved proof for the selected activity and additional competition proof before listing at this level.

items.title: Sign in
items.body: Create or sign in to a PacerGo account before opening the partner studio.

items.title: Save your listing
items.body: Add a headline, introduction, service area, and listing status.

items.title: Add offerings
items.body: Choose activities, levels, session details, and submit proof when a level requires review.

items.title: Set availability
items.body: Add weekly bookable times and keep your listing accurate before users discover it.

standards.intro: Partner responsibilities should support respectful, safer workouts without creating false promises.

items.title: Accurate profile information
items.body: Describe your experience, area, services, and status truthfully.

items.title: Stay within your qualifications
items.body: Do not present professional credentials unless they have been submitted and approved where required.

items.title: Respectful communication
items.body: Coordinate clearly, protect user privacy, and keep interactions appropriate.

items.title: Use safety tools
items.body: Follow platform rules and report safety concerns when they arise.

cta.sub: Open PacerGo, sign in, and continue to the partner studio when you are ready.
